card.name: Digits inside section cross-references
card.fires_on: A single digit in a numbered section reference such as (5.4), (2.3, 5.1) or (12.3), usually in parentheses or brackets in label text. Also fires on pieces inside brand names like XARELTO and MYRBETRIQ.

modes.label: Section reference digits
modes.description: A digit within a numbered cross-reference to another label section, often just before or after a decimal point.

modes.label: Digits in dose numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal or strength figure in a dose or concentration.
